purpose: Separate prelaunch economics readiness from realized Final Net Profit truth without substituting reserves or assumptions for actual costs.
rules: Projected Product Contribution is not Final Net Profit.
A test/sandbox order may validate evidence capture but never counts as realized revenue or Final Net Profit.
Final Net Profit requires a real non-test order and complete required cost evidence.
Any missing required cost input keeps Final Net Profit UNKNOWN.
Tax/import responsibility may be verified before launch, but actual order economics still require realized order evidence.
No live payment activation, supplier order, price change or Production mutation from this contract.
